name: Wall March
setup: Hands on a wall at shoulder height, body leaning in at a sprint angle.
cues: Drive one knee up toward the wall, then switch, slow and sharp.
Stay tall, like a string pulls the top of your head to the ceiling.

faults.fault: Leaning back as the knee lifts
faults.fix: Stay tall over the floor, like the string pulls you up.
Quick, quiet contacts under you on the ball of the foot.

name: Falling Start
